claim: Handler bytes are category-scoped; Support dispatches $00/$02/$0B/$0D/$0F via Bank00:$3A6C independently of offensive handler meanings.
Support handlers $00/$02 share a fixed BG resource $19 visual path; $0B/$0D/$0F override states before that helper and do not inherit it.
Bank68:$19 is 16 tiles assembled as 7 rows × 6 tiles at BG row4/col7, palette slot5; it is one static 48×56 BG graphic, not seven animation frames.
Common Support passes card CC15 directly as palette index; palette $FF is physically consumed as index255 and is not universally NONE.
Kiai $40 and Paralysis $29 are loaded into card AnimationSlot6 but no Support worker or Support macro starts that slot.
Defense selection is a CA02 FSM; CA55=0/default Guard, 1 Defense card, 2 Move.
Move commits a 2-bit FighterState tactical position, while ROM macros $29/$2A perform local net-zero cinematic movement.
Defense selection preloads AnimationSlot8; only two global ActionObject start sites consume slot8: STANDARD_DAMAGE $60B2 and Beam $59FD.
Defense card IDs map exactly to CA83 flags: Taiyoken 01/81, Teleport 02, Barrier/Breath 04, TimeFreeze/Telepathy/Foresight 40, EnergyAbsorb 08, Endurance 10, Shockwave 01, Avoiding 02.
CA83 result flags produce distinct numeric CA53 states; CA53=2 is Endurance/partial and is not universally MISS.
Sunglasses sets fighter status+7 bit08; Taiyoken checks that bit and writes CA83=$81 when countered; STANDARD_DAMAGE then bypasses Taiyoken cancellation and continues.
CA83 bit40 clears the ten-byte Stage/Command success buffer CA6A..CA73 before non-Damage/non-Beam resolution.
On STANDARD_DAMAGE CA83&1 route, selected card $7C Shockwave skips slot8 and queues macro $38; Taiyoken uses slot8.
Beam CA53=3/4 result route starts slot8; CA53=1 Avoid and CA53=2 Endurance do not.
Taiyoken/Barrier/Breath/EnergyAbsorb resources are started on known attack routes; Teleport/TimeFreeze resources are preloaded but not statically started on their defining routes.
Bank68:$1A is shared by CHARA with palette $31 and Gather Power with palette $33; common Support uses $19 instead.
All Support paths perform an initial card-indexed load through $2C30 using banks beginning at $6B; this path is indexed by card ID and is separate from offensive FXResource loader $2B30.
